description.value:
You can drain power from ongoing spells to recharge your allies' magic. As a Magic Action, you can touch a willing creature and end one ongoing spell of 1st or 2nd level affecting it; the creature immediately recovers one expended Spell Slot of 2nd level or lower (the target's choice).

If the target has no ongoing 1st- or 2nd-level spell affecting it, you can instead use this Magic Action and expend up to 2 Resonance of your own to allow the target to recover one expended Spell Slot. The Slot recovered is of a level equal to the amount of Resonance you expended (a maximum of 2nd level).

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

Automated: the Fimblewood Academy module lets you pick a willing target and, if they have an ongoing 1st- or 2nd-level spell effect, ends it and restores a spell slot of the target's choice automatically. Otherwise it lets you spend up to 2 Resonance to restore a slot of the corresponding level. Tracks the once-per-rest use automatically.

source.custom: Fimblewood Academy homebrew, adapted from "Unblooded Sorcery" (2026).
